31595-the-return-of-the-prodigal.title: The Prodigal
31595-the-return-of-the-prodigal.creator: May Sinclair
31595-the-return-of-the-prodigal.description: A book by May Sinclair. He let himself be looked at; he sat there in his corner seat, superbly, opulently still. And somehow it dawned on you that, in spite of some Americanisms he let fall, he was not, and never could have been, a Yankee. He had evidently forged ahead at a tremendous speed, but it was weight, not steam, that did it.

52804-the-squaw-man-a-novel.title: The Squaw Man A Novel
52804-the-squaw-man-a-novel.creator: Unknown
52804-the-squaw-man-a-novel.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Lady Kerhill elevated her eyebrows in questioning amazement at Jim, as she nervously twisted the lace of her gown, and with an impatient gesture motioned the subject aside. She was a tall, angular woman, with a profile like the head on a bronze coin; there was a suggestion of the eagle in her personality, and by her friends she was likened to the famous Sarah Churchill, the first Duchess of Marlborough.

arxiv-2106-05807.title: Quantum Speedup of Natural Gradient for Variational Bayes
arxiv-2106-05807.creator: Anna Lopatnikova, Minh-Ngoc Tran
arxiv-2106-05807.description: Abstract Variational Bayes (VB) is a critical method in machine learning and statistics, underpinning the recent success of Bayesian deep learning. The natural gradient is an essential component of efficient VB estimation, but it is prohibitively computationally expensive in high dimensions. We propose a computationally efficient regression-based method for natural gradient estimation, with convergence guarantees under standard assumptions.

arxiv-2112-10587.title: Image-free multi-character recognition
arxiv-2112-10587.creator: Huayi Wang, 1 Chunli Zhu, 1 Liheng Bian, 1,∗
arxiv-2112-10587.description: Abstract The recently developed image-free sensing technique maintains the advantages of both the light hardware and software, which has been applied in simple target classification and motion tracking. In practical applications, however, there usually exist multiple targets in the field of view, where existing trials fail to produce multi-semantic information.

arxiv-2203-06310.title: Island and Page curve for one-sided asymptotically flat black hole
arxiv-2203-06310.creator: Wen-Cong Gan, Dong-Hui Du, Fu-Wen Shu
arxiv-2203-06310.description: Abstract Great breakthrough in solving black hole information paradox took place when semiclassical island rule for entanglement entropy of Hawking radiation was proposed in recent years. Up to now, most papers which discussed island rule of asymptotic flat black hole with D ≥ 4 D\geq 4 focus on eternal black hole.

arxiv-2210-00998.title: Effects of porous media on the phase behaviour of polypeptide solutions
arxiv-2210-00998.creator: V. I. Shmotolokha, M. F. Holovko
arxiv-2210-00998.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by V. I. Shmotolokha, M. F. Holovko. The generalized van der Waals equation for anisotropic fluids in porous media, proposed by the authors in previous works, is used to describe the effect of porous media on the phase behavior of polypeptide solutions.

arxiv-2301-11537.title: Behavior under magnetic field of resonance at the edge of the upper Hubbard band in 1 T T -TaS 2
arxiv-2301-11537.creator: C. J. Butler, M. Yoshida, T. Hanaguri, Y. Iwasa
arxiv-2301-11537.description: Abstract Recent theoretical investigations of quantum spin liquids have described phenomenology amenable to experimental observation using scanning tunneling microscopy. This includes characteristic resonances found at the edge of the upper Hubbard band of the host Mott insulator, that under certain conditions shift into the Mott gap under external magnetic field [W.-Y. He and P. A. Lee, arXiv:2212.08767 ].

arxiv-2304-03474.title: Kipriyanov’s Fractional Calculus Prehistory and Legacy
arxiv-2304-03474.creator: Maksim V. Kukushkin
arxiv-2304-03474.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maksim V. Kukushkin. This paper is partly a historical survey of various approaches and methods in the fractional calculus, partly a description of the Kipriyanov extraordinary theory in comparison with the classical one. The significance and outstanding methods in constructing the independent Kipriyanov fractional calculus theory are convexly stressed, also we represent modern results involving the Kipriyanov operator and corresponding generalization under the semigroup theory point of view.

arxiv-2309-11256.title: Tropical cryptography III: digital signatures
arxiv-2309-11256.creator: Jiale Chen, Dima Grigoriev, Vladimir Shpilrain
arxiv-2309-11256.description: Abstract We use tropical algebras as platforms for a very efficient digital signature protocol. Security relies on computational hardness of factoring one-variable tropical polynomials; this problem is known to be NP-hard. We also offer countermeasures against recent attacks by Panny and by Brown and Monico.

arxiv-2407-15190.title: Information measures for fermion localization in f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) gravity with non-minimal couplings
arxiv-2407-15190.creator: Allan R. P. Moreira, Shi-Hai Dong, Emmanuel N. Saridakis
arxiv-2407-15190.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Allan R. P. Moreira, Shi-Hai Dong, Emmanuel N. Saridakis. We investigate the dynamics of fermion localization within the framework of f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) gravity featuring non-minimal couplings. Starting from the Dirac action for a spin- 1 / 2 1/2 fermion in a five-dimensional spacetime governed by torsional f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) gravity, we derive the Dirac equation and we explore its solutions under various non-minimal coupling functions.

arxiv-2504-15343.title: The Hardness of Learning Quantum Circuits and its Cryptographic Applications
arxiv-2504-15343.creator: Bill Fefferman, Soumik Ghosh, Makrand Sinha, Henry Yuen
arxiv-2504-15343.description: Abstract We show that concrete hardness assumptions about learning or cloning the output state of a random quantum circuit can be used as the foundation for secure quantum cryptography. In particular, under these assumptions we construct secure one-way state generators (OWSGs), digital signature schemes, quantum bit commitments, and private key encryption schemes.

arxiv-2505-19971.title: Conversational Lexicography: Querying Lexicographic Data on Knowledge Graphs with SPARQL through Natural Language
arxiv-2505-19971.creator: Kilian Sennrich, Sina Ahmadi
arxiv-2505-19971.description: Abstract Knowledge graphs offer an excellent solution for representing the lexical-semantic structures of lexicographic data. However, working with the SPARQL query language represents a considerable hurdle for many non-expert users who could benefit from the advantages of this technology. This paper addresses the challenge of creating natural language interfaces for lexicographic data retrieval on knowledge graphs such as Wikidata.

arxiv-2510-09587.title: Ab initio study on photocatalytic properties of PtSSe-WXY Janus heterostructures
arxiv-2510-09587.creator: Shivprasad S. Shastri, Antonio Cammarata, Tomas Polcar
arxiv-2510-09587.description: Abstract Semiconductor photocatalysis offers a sustainable route for converting solar energy into chemical energy, enabling the production of clean fuels and valuable chemical products. To this aim, we explore van der Waals heterostructures made up of Janus PtSSe and WXY (X, Y = = S, Se, Te and X ≠ \neq Y), in the context of photocatalytic applications.

pmc-11388458.creator: Sarea
pmc-11388458.description: Microporous annealed particle (MAP) hydrogels are a promising class of in situ-forming scaffolds for tissue repair and regeneration. While an expansive toolkit of annealing chemistries has been described, the effects of different annealing chemistries on MAP hydrogel properties and performance have not been studied.

pmc-12579925.title: Deep learning approaches for resolving genomic discrepancies in cancer: a systematic review and clinical perspective
pmc-12579925.creator: Muhammad Zubair, Ali Haider Khan, Syed Fakhar Bilal, Jianqiang Li
pmc-12579925.description: Discrepancies in cancer sequencing data continue to pose significant challenges for accurate mutation detection, potentially resulting in misdiagnoses and suboptimal treatment strategies. Although deep learning (DL) has emerged as a transformative approach for identifying and rectifying these errors, there remains a lack of comprehensive evaluation of DL architectures, performance benchmarks, and clinical translation.

pmc-12743096.title: The influence of cell phenotype on collective cell invasion into the extracellular matrix
pmc-12743096.creator: Yuan Yin, Sarah L Waters, Ruth E Baker
pmc-12743096.description: Understanding the interactions between cells and the extracellular matrix (ECM) during collective cell invasion is crucial for advancements in tissue engineering, cancer therapies, and regenerative medicine. This study focuses on the roles of contact guidance and ECM remodelling in directing cell behaviour, with a particular emphasis on exploring how differences in cell phenotype impact collective cell invasion.

pmc-12844049.title: Toward Rational Design of Ion-Exchange Nanofiber Membranes: Meso-Scale Computational Approaches
pmc-12844049.creator: Inci Boztepe, Shuaifei Zhao, Xing Yang, Lingxue Kong
pmc-12844049.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This review highlights the growing relevance of ion-exchange nanofibrous membranes (IEX-NFMs) in membrane chromatography (MC) for protein purification, emphasising their structural advantages such as high porosity, tunable surface functionality, and low-pressure drops. While the adsorption of IEX-NFMs in MC is expanding due to their potential for high throughput and rapid mass transfer, a critical limitation remains: the precise binding capacity of these membranes is not well understood.

pmc-13306252.creator: Sabrina Vollrath, Anne-Sophie Koller, Norman Bitterlich, Ana Buadze, Alexandra S. Kohl Schwartz, Petra Stute, Anthony C. Hackney, Nathalie Werth

pmc-13324582.title: Sex-specific effects of maternal gestational diabetes mellitus on offspring neurodevelopment: persistent hippocampal neurogenesis deficits in female but not male offspring
pmc-13324582.creator: Xiafei Wu, Huisheng Ge, Jie Fang, Jie He, Hongbing Xu, Yangyu Zhao, Philip N. Baker, Xinyang Yu, Yubin Ding, Hongbo Qi
pmc-13324582.description: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) represents a prevalent pregnancy complication with long-term health implications for offspring. While metabolic outcomes have been extensively studied, sex-specific effects on neurodevelopment remain poorly understood. Here we investigated the sex-dependent impact of maternal GDM on offspring brain development and behavior using a high-fat diet and low-dose streptozotocin induced mouse model.
